## Documentation (no master shell script)

There is **no single shell script** for the full PD20–22 AUTO chain. Regeneration is documented in:

| Doc | Path |
|-----|------|
| HAND20 slide map + workflow | `/Users/charleslevine/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/1-Documents/00- Dissertation/0-Next_Chapter/Code_and_Data/New SQL and PY Code/Cursor Workspace PDE/3-Master_Plan/re_entry/HEROs_and_PASSes/slides/README.txt` (lines 149–222) |
| PD20 | `.../pd20_temperature/REGENERATE.md` |
| PD21 | `.../pd21_rho/README.md` |
| PD22 | `.../pd22_minutes/README.md` |
| Campaign narrative | `.../PD20_22_campaign_big_picture.md` |

`./scripts/build_characterization_slides.sh` is **PD16 only**, not PD20–22.

---

## Path conventions

**`hero_gallery_paths.py`** — canonical roots and AUTO deck constants:

- Output dirs: `PD20_TEMPERATURE`, `PD21_RHO`, `PD22_MINUTES`, `SLIDES_AUTO`
- AUTO decks: `AUTO_PD20_DECK`, `AUTO_PD21_RHO_DECK`, `AUTO_PD22_*_DECK`, `AUTO_PD20_22_MEMO_DECK`
- HAND masters (`CHAR_PD20_HAND.pptx`) are **never** written by scripts

**`interval_overlap_paths.py`** — window tagging:

- `window_tag(2013, 2021)` → `"2013_2021"`
- `seasons_label(2013, 2021)` → `"2013-2021"` (display)

**Artifact filename pattern (PNG/CSV/JSON):**

```
{PREFIX}_{window_tag}[_{variant}].{ext}
```

Examples:
- `GRANDCHILD_temperature_select_sweep_2011_2021.png`
- `PD21_rho_hsort_calibrate_2013_2021_fit_bracket.json`
- `PD21_rho_hsort_calibrate_2011_2021_ppm0lt20_bracket.png`
- `PD22_drafted_minutes_audit_2011_2021.png`
- `PD22_interval_overlap_season_2012.png` (single season, no window tag)

**AUTO `.pptx` names** are mostly **fixed** (no window suffix). Exception: PD21 contrast decks insert `_ppm0lt20` before `_AUTO`.

**`memo_slide_common.py`** — typography + narrative slide builders (`append_hand_companion_slide`, etc.); used only by the memo deck.

**`pd21_slide_common.py` / `pd22_slide_common.py`** — HAND-paste bullet text and math helpers; hardcode `"2011–2021"` in panel descriptions.

---

| Already supports CLI | Hardcoded `2011`/`2021` (needs modification for 2013–2021) |
|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| `grandchild_temperature_select_sweep.py` | All `pd22_*.py` analysis scripts |
| `grandchild_temperature_cold_limit_diagnostic.py` | All `build_pd22_*.py` slide scripts |

| | `build_pd21_rho_hsort_timeseries_slide.py` |
| | `build_pd20_22_takeaways_memo.py` (JSON paths + counts) |
| | `pd21_slide_common.py` (prose) |

PD22 interval slides use `--season 2012|2013` only (single-season), not a window.

## Ordered full regeneration chain

Run from repo root. Use `PY=/opt/anaconda3/envs/sports_net/bin/python` if that is your env (per `REGENERATE.md`).

### Phase 1 — PD20 figures + AUTO (HAND slides 1–4)

```bash
# 1a. Temperature sweep (heavy — full panel)
python sports/scripts/grandchild_temperature_select_sweep.py
# → pd20_temperature/GRANDCHILD_temperature_select_sweep_2011_2021.{png,meta.json}

# 1b. Cold limit (rule C vs D)
python sports/scripts/grandchild_temperature_cold_limit_diagnostic.py
# → pd20_temperature/GRANDCHILD_temperature_cold_limit_2011_2021.{png,meta.json}

# 1c. AUTO deck
python sports/scripts/build_pd20_hand_slides.py --slides-only
# → slides/auto/CHAR_PD20_HAND_AUTO.pptx
```

### Phase 2 — PD22 panel backup (HAND slides 5–13)

```bash
# Roster / games / ESPN (box QC before/after)
python sports/scripts/pd22_raw_roster_size_distribution.py --before-qc-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_raw_roster_size_before_qc_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_team_season_games_count.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_team_season_games_count_slide.py --slides-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_team_season_games_count_after_qc_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_raw_roster_size_distribution.py --after-qc-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_raw_roster_size_after_qc_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_espn_coverage_by_season.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_espn_coverage_by_season_slide.py --slides-only

# Minutes / PPM / draft audit
python sports/scripts/pd22_drafted_minutes_audit.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_drafted_minutes_audit_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_raw_minutes_distribution.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_raw_minutes_distribution_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_ppm_distribution.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_ppm_distribution_slide.py --slides-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_ppm_full_vs_filtered_slide.py --slides-only
```

### Phase 3 — PD21 ρ calibration (HAND slides 14–16)

```bash
# Hero panel (locked) — heavy bracket search
python sports/scripts/pd21_rho_hsort_calibrate.py --n-seeds 50 --n-jobs 8 --fresh

# Contrast arm
python sports/scripts/pd21_rho_hsort_calibrate.py --n-seeds 50 --n-jobs 8 --fresh --ppm-zero-below-minutes 20

# AUTO slides
python sports/scripts/build_pd21_rho_hsort_calibrate_slide.py --slides-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd21_rho_hsort_calibrate_slide.py --ppm-zero-below-minutes 20 --slides-only
python sports/scripts/build_pd21_rho_hsort_timeseries_slide.py --ppm-zero-below-minutes 20 --slides-only
```

### Phase 4 — PD22 policy + overlap (HAND slides 17–21)

```bash
python sports/scripts/pd22_ppm_zero_ability_distribution.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_ppm_zero_ability_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_ppm_zero_hsort_mechanism.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_ppm_zero_hsort_mechanism_slide.py --slides-only

# Needs PD21 fit JSONs + item 8 season CSV
python sports/scripts/pd22_panel_policy_compare.py
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_panel_policy_compare_slide.py --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_interval_overlap_season.py --season 2012
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_interval_overlap_season_slide.py --season 2012 --slides-only

python sports/scripts/pd22_interval_overlap_season.py --season 2013
python sports/scripts/build_pd22_interval_overlap_season_slide.py --season 2013 --slides-only
```

### Phase 5 — Narrative companion memo (not in HAND deck)

```bash
python sports/scripts/build_pd20_22_takeaways_memo.py
# → slides/auto/CHAR_PD20_22_takeaways_memo_AUTO.pptx
```

## `build_pd20_22_takeaways_memo.py` role

**Last step in the chain** — does **not** compute figures or rebuild panels.

- Reads locked JSON on disk (hardcoded `_2011_2021` paths):
  - `GRANDCHILD_temperature_select_sweep_2011_2021_meta.json`
  - `PD21_rho_hsort_calibrate_2011_2021_fit_bracket.json`
  - `PD21_rho_hsort_calibrate_2011_2021_ppm0lt20_fit_bracket.json`
  - `PD22_panel_policy_compare_2011_2021.json`
  - `PD22_drafted_minutes_audit_2011_2021.json`
  - `PD22_interval_overlap_season_{2012,2013}.json`
- Uses `memo_slide_common.py` to build ~46 narrative slides (wavetops → snag Q&A → one companion per HAND slide → closing).
- Writes `slides/auto/CHAR_PD20_22_takeaways_memo_AUTO.pptx` via `AUTO_PD20_22_MEMO_DECK`.
